name: com.infodenconsultancy/infoden
title: Infoden Consultancy
description: Register companies in Zimbabwe, South Africa and Dubai, find open tenders, run your business tools.

tools.name: list_services_catalogue
tools.description: Public, no sign-in required. List the services Infoden offers (company registration packages, tax services, IP filings, etc.), optionally filtered by jurisdiction or category.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction code or name, e.g. 'ZW', 'zimbabwe', 'ZA', 'AE'. Omit for all jurisdictions.

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for paging past the first `limit` results.

tools.name: list_jurisdictions
tools.description: Public, no sign-in required. List the jurisdictions (countries) Infoden serves, with an honest status per jurisdiction: 'live' (fully operational, e.g. Zimbabwe) or 'pilot' (intake is collected but delivered through a licensed local filing agent, with a human handling every step — never automated filing). Each entry also carries an `availability` of 'bookable' or 'enquiry_only'. 'enquiry_only' means Infoden's published requirements for that jurisdiction are an unconfirmed draft: you may take an enquiry, but must not present it as something the user can book or as settled fact. Call get_registration_requirements for the detail.

tools.name: get_registration_requirements
tools.description: Public, no sign-in required. Returns exactly what a company registration in this jurisdiction requires: how many proposed names, the minimum number of directors and shareholders, every role that must be named, and the precise field list for each person — plus whether identity is by national ID or passport, whether a passport copy upload is needed, whether signatures are required, and whether the business activity is free text or must come from an approved list. Use the `checklist` array to walk someone through it conversationally, and `roles` when you need the exact fields. Check `bookable`: when it is false the jurisdiction is enquiry-only and its requirements are an unconfirmed draft, so tell the user Infoden will confirm the final list rather than presenting it as settled.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction code or name, e.g. 'ZW', 'zimbabwe', 'ZA', 'AE'. Call list_jurisdictions for the current list.

tools.name: request_registration_quote
tools.description: Public, no sign-in. Like Infoden's 'get a quote' form: returns an indicative quote, the requirement checklist and a secure single-use link to send full details later, and creates a lead for a consultant. It creates no company, charges nothing and approves nothing. Before calling, get the person's explicit consent (Infoden will use their name, email and phone to answer the enquiry) and pass consentAccepted only if they agree. Never pass ID or passport numbers, dates of birth, addresses or documents. With an email, a code is emailed and verify_registration_interest must be called with it before a consultant is told; phone-only enquiries go straight through.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction code or name, e.g. 'ZW', 'zimbabwe', 'ZA'. Call list_jurisdictions first.

entityType.description: Entity/company type code, e.g. 'private_limited', 'pty_ltd', 'mainland_llc'. Required for some jurisdictions — get_registration_requirements says which via entityType.required.

proposedNames.description: Proposed company names in order of preference, up to 5.

businessActivity.description: A short description of what the business will do.

directorCount.description: How many directors the company will have.

shareholderCount.description: How many shareholders the company will have.

contact.description: A single point of contact. Do not pass details for anyone else here.

consentAccepted.description: Must be true, and must reflect the user actually agreeing to Infoden processing their contact details. Never assume it.

tools.name: verify_registration_interest
tools.description: Public, no sign-in required. Call this after request_registration_quote returns a 'pending_verification' status with an emailed code, passing that registrationId and the code the submitter received. Only on success does an Infoden consultant get notified — this is the spam/abuse control on the unauthenticated submission endpoint, not a real identity check. If the quote request withheld a secure intake link, this returns it on success.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Public, no sign-in required. Full-text-style search across jurisdictions, the service catalogue, published registration-requirement schemas, and published blog posts. Returns a short list of { id, title, url } results — call fetch with a result's id to get its full content. Also searches open tenders and grants (ids tender:<id>).

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Public, no sign-in required. Fetches the full content for an id returned by search: `service:<uuid>`, `jurisdiction:<code>`, `requirements:<code>`, or `blog:<slug>`. Returns { id, title, text, url, metadata }. Also fetches tender:<id> results.

tools.name: search_tenders
tools.description: Public, no sign-in. Search the open tenders, RFQs, supplier registrations and grants Infoden's opportunity network lists (Zimbabwe first, plus the region), soonest closing first. Each result links to its page on infodenconsultancy.com, which shows the original listing after a free sign-in. Infoden takes NO applications and charges nothing for listings. Use get_tender for one listing in full.

tools.name: get_tender
tools.description: Public, no sign-in. One tender, RFQ, supplier registration or grant in full (description, requirements, eligibility, closing date) and its page on infodenconsultancy.com. Infoden takes no applications: the person applies through the original listing, shown on that page after a free sign-in.

id.description: An id (or its first 8 characters) from search_tenders.

tools.name: search_help_articles
tools.description: Public, no sign-in. Search Infoden's Help Centre (how to register a company, invoice, invite a team, connect PayNow, use the portal) or open one guide by id.
